tasks.details:
Create Python 3.11+ package, Streamlit entrypoint, dependency lock/requirements, typed configuration, Development default, sanitised logging, pytest unit suite and no-secret checks. Initial offline Streamlit importer and SQLite skeleton committed; environment/contract tests and live carrier integration remain outstanding.

COMPLETED: typed AppConfig with development default; Streamlit smoke test; allowlisted audit logging; config/secret redaction tests; unit CI passed, PR #2.
tasks.testStrategy: Start the app with no SAP/SQL driver, validate .env startup errors without exposing credentials and pass CI/mock-only test suite.

tasks.details:
Create imports, orders, shipments, shipment_pieces, attempts, documents and audit_events tables; uniqueness constraints and atomic transactions; restart/backup migration tests.

PROGRESS NOTE — 2026-10-27 audit: SQLite store includes imports/orders/audit records plus placeholder shipments/attempts/pieces/documents tables. Reimport preservation and restart tests exist. Still missing migrations, atomic non-idempotent carrier request journal, uniqueness/locking guards, and document persistence implementation. NOT done.

COMPLETED: journal migration v2, unique transaction claim, durable attempt before network call, reconciliation state on ambiguous responses, per-piece PINs, atomic PDF archive and SQLite restart/concurrency tests; offline GitHub Actions green, PR #3.
tasks.testStrategy: Reload a saved draft/successful shipment with all identifiers after process restart; concurrent conflicting writes fail safely.

tasks.title: Implement XLSX/CSV SAP order importer and column aliases
tasks.details:
Parse Orders and optional OrderLines; normalize DocEntry/DocNum/strings, headers, statuses; preserve import provenance; avoid unsafe formulas/macros/path use; repeated imports must preserve shipped rows.

PROGRESS NOTE — 2026-10-27 audit: XLSX Orders/optional OrderLines plus CSV parsing implemented, SAP alias mapping, import validation, duplicate DocEntry handling, file-size cap, source checksum and open-order checks; template downloadable. Still need comprehensive mapping cases, row errors, validated source update policy and fuller fixtures. NOT done.

COMPLETED: Orders/OrderLines XLSX and CSV, SAP aliases, source provenance, strict identity/status checks, oversized/invalid workbook rejection, duplicate detection; edgecase CI passed, PR #4.
tasks.testStrategy: Synthetic workbook loads correctly; missing/ambiguous columns return row-specific errors; duplicate imports do not erase shipment state.

tasks.title: Enforce order-level Ship To address and line-level destination rules
tasks.details:
Map RDR12 *S shipping columns exclusively; keep CRD1 selected Ship To as optional reviewed reference; never use *B billing. Validate province/country/postal/units; block multi-destination orders pending explicit split.

PROGRESS NOTE — 2026-10-27 audit: RDR12 *S fields enforced, *B fields excluded, Canadian postal/province checks and line-level destination conflict detection, with regression tests. Carrier payload mapping and full address/multi-destination handling remain. NOT done.
tasks.testStrategy: A deliberately different Bill To never appears in recipient payload; missing RDR12 fields and multiple line ShipToCode combinations block shipping.
